findings.reason: The cited evidence shows the holiday event and traffic deviations, supporting the inference that the holiday caused the reduced traffic.
T1 explicitly states no detector alerts for the network in the specified time window.
T2 lists deviations below baseline for all three metrics with an onset of 2026-09-03 07:15.
EVT-001, T3, and T7 all confirm the nationwide public holiday started at 2026-09-03 00:00 and is in progress.
T4 explicitly reports no maintenance window scheduled on any node in the specified time window.
CHG-2026-0003 and T8 confirm one software upgrade on S-SUD-003 at 2026-09-03 01:35.
The cited evidence links the holiday event to the observed traffic drop, making the inference reasonable.
